title: City Emergency Hotlines
description: Emergency and public-service numbers the city government publishes, each cited to civic sources by id (src/data/sources/civic-sources.json). A number is listed only when at least two independent official lists state it; see docs/civic-data-verification.md. Mirrors CityHotline in src/types/directoryTypes.ts.

slug.description: Stable identifier, unique in the file.

name.description: Short name as the city publishes it, e.g. "PNP Dagupan".

full_name.description: The longer name the city's directory prints beneath the short one, as published. Null when the directory prints none.

category.description: Display grouping assigned by this portal, not a field published by the city.

numbers.description: Numbers in the order the city lists them. Landlines carry the (075) area code; mobiles are 11-digit 09xx numbers.

sources.description: Civic-source ids of the official pages that state these numbers. At least two.
